# Frozen PTC coefficient and named-use authority

## Source cover

P01 freezes SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5. Its final status-clean hashes bind these
normative sources. Only the quoted clauses are admitted; macro arguments are
requirement/definition identity and provenance, not access to omitted files.
The generic operators define a family interface, not a prescribed statistic
or uniform-family formula. Source symbols Z and Y denote the transformed and
immutable calibrated parent respectively; eta is a declared diagnostic, chi
its declared context, and the normalization domain is exact. The new uniform
family is not required to depend on a residual statistic merely because the
generic notation permits such input.

These clauses preserve PTC fitting and signal meaning. PTC-OD-010 remained
open in the frozen packet; the approved registry framework is later successor
input in REGISTRY_FRAMEWORK.md. No frozen clause is silently changed here.
The first-family constant, unit and normalization remain author proposals for
owner review. Coefficient values do not become formal precision by naming or
units. Definitions and equations of omitted PTC fitting/response operations
remain outside the new derivation; request missing material if necessary.

## Definition 001

Source: P05; whole-source SHA-256 `904ffa5292aa0ec0ca89cd6b69567d50dfcd9578d6cf7729d96d01ec78ab63c5`.

<!-- EXCERPT PTC_COEFFICIENTS-Definition 001 -->
```tex
\PTCDefinition{001}{Admitted CAL parent}{The immutable SCI-CAL detector-time product accepted by all required unit, identity, validity, lineage, uncertainty, and response gates. It is the numerical parent of every base-v0.1 fit and support-changing refit.}
```
<!-- END EXCERPT PTC_COEFFICIENTS-Definition 001 -->

## Definition 003

Source: P05; whole-source SHA-256 `904ffa5292aa0ec0ca89cd6b69567d50dfcd9578d6cf7729d96d01ec78ab63c5`.

<!-- EXCERPT PTC_COEFFICIENTS-Definition 003 -->
```tex
\PTCDefinition{003}{Transformed detector signal}{The operator-primary result $Z=\mathcal A_\Theta(Y^{\rm CAL})$ after discarding the learned additive detector reference, applying the realized correlated-mode operation, and restoring only invertible internal scaling. The total removed signal is defined as $U_{{\rm total},\Theta}(Y^{\rm CAL})=Y^{\rm CAL}-Z$ rather than identified with the fitted correlated component alone. The discarded reference carries no scientifically meaningful optical DC information. The result is not an independent sky estimate.}
```
<!-- END EXCERPT PTC_COEFFICIENTS-Definition 003 -->

## Generic diagnostic and coefficient construction

Source: P03; whole-source SHA-256 `af4418116e2fd8d827dd8f149bf16af36a95f2155976644ea6148224faf86f9d`.

<!-- EXCERPT PTC_COEFFICIENTS-Generic diagnostic and coefficient construction -->
```tex
A diagnostic indexed by detector or detector-time occurrence may take the
generic residual form
\begin{equation}
\eta_i=H_i(Z,\widehat U_{\rm corr},U_{{\rm total},\Theta},
\mathcal S,\Theta;\chi_H),
\label{eq:diagnostic}
\end{equation}
where $\chi_H$ records the domain, population/model reference, normalization,
support, uncertainty, and policy role.

A downstream analysis/gridding coefficient family is
\begin{equation}
\widetilde\gamma_i=f_{\gamma}(\eta_i;\chi_{\gamma}),
\qquad
\gamma_i=
\mathcal N_{\gamma}\!\left(
\widetilde\gamma_i;\{\widetilde\gamma_j:j\in\mathcal D_{\gamma}\}\right),
\label{eq:analysis-coefficient}
\end{equation}
where $i=d$ or $i=(t,d)$ is declared, $\mathcal D_{\gamma}$ is the exact
normalization domain, and $f_{\gamma}$ and $\mathcal N_{\gamma}$ are named
operators. The result is not precision unless separately proved.

```
<!-- END EXCERPT PTC_COEFFICIENTS-Generic diagnostic and coefficient construction -->
